## Changes

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and effect on users or results.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py --check`
- [ ] `node --test tests/alignment.test.cjs`
- [ ] Exercise the changed behavior in a browser

For visual changes, include desktop and narrow-layout screenshots.

## Context

Link related issues and references. State the origin and usage conditions of new code/data.

Do not add version prefixes to commit subjects or create version tags.
